bottleneck.description: Global #1 pneumatic automation supplier (~30% global share) of solenoid valves, cylinders, and air treatment equipment for factory automation.

dependency.key_customers: TSMC, Samsung, semiconductor fab equipment makers (AMAT, ASML), automotive OEMs, packaging machine builders
dependency.key_suppliers: Aluminum/steel suppliers, valve coil and electronics suppliers

editorial.notes: SMC is the clear global leader in pneumatic components with ~30% share, ahead of Festo, Parker-Hannifin, Airtac, and CKD. Pneumatic valves are qualified into specific automation lines (semi front-end tools, packaging, automotive assembly) where re-qualification takes months, supporting MEDIUM. Below HIGH because the pneumatic technology stack itself has many capable players globally, and pneumatics is partially substitutable by electric actuators.
